title: Personal templates
intro: Make a personal copy of a page you can read, then create a new private page in this workspace.
copyBoundary: A saved template is an independent copy. Source edits and permission revocation do not recall it. Leaving and rejoining the workspace will not restore previous templates.
exclusionBoundary: Attachments, databases, child pages, comments, mentions, link metadata, import sources and unsupported blocks are excluded. Structured link labels are omitted too. Review ordinary code and literal text yourself: secrets in them cannot be detected automatically.
quota: Up to 50 templates per current membership. Each is limited to 32 KiB and 200 blocks; the workspace storage limit also applies.
signIn: Sign in with a verified account.
accountsDisabled: Accounts are disabled on this server.
contentDisabled: Workspace storage is unavailable on this server.
denied: This account cannot use personal templates. Guests are not eligible.
unavailable: Could not load the content. Your input is retained.
conflict: Saved content has changed. Your input is retained. Refresh the list and review the content before trying again.
accountChanged: The account changed. The operation stopped. Check your session.
emptyHint: Choose a page and review omissions before saving.
noPages: No eligible pages. Databases and record pages are excluded.
consentCopy: I reviewed the omissions and will save an independent personal copy.
literal: Content is displayed as literal text. Links do not open.
deleteConfirm: Delete this personal copy. Previously created pages and request receipts remain.
applyTitle: Create a page from this template
applyBoundary: Create one new private page at the top level of this workspace. Sharing, attachments, databases and source relationships are not inherited.
consentApply: Create a new page that only I can read from the displayed copy.
confirmApply: Create private page with this content
unknown: The result is unknown. The request ID is retained. The operation is not resent automatically and no new page is created.
pending: The previous request needs review. Only its result will be requested; content will not be sent.
receiptUnavailable: The result could not be confirmed. This does not prove that nothing happened, so no new request was started.
resultGone: The request completed, but its result was deleted or is no longer readable. It was not created again.
limit: A storage limit was reached. Check template and page counts and sizes.
unsupported: Databases and record pages cannot be template sources.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
